items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to his hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury continuing to sideline him from practice.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 7; monitor Friday report for designation.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Xavier Worthy and other KC WRs if OUT.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list; also placed TE Elijah Arroyo on IR with season-ending shoulder surgery.
items.why: 21-day window expired; full participant Wednesday; possible limited role Sunday vs KC.
items.implication: Immediate depth chart addition for SEA RBs; Arroyo out for season opens TE snaps.
items.opportunity: Charbonnet goal-line/short-yardage upside shares with Price; handcuff or flex watch.

items.text: Bears ruled out RB Kyle Monangai for TNF vs Patriots; misses third straight with thumb/turf toe.
items.implication: Full workload likely for Swift in TNF.
items.opportunity: Swift snap/carry/red-zone upgrade as clear lead back.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice on Thursday per Jets injury report.
items.why: Returned to practice after sitting Wednesday; not ruled out.
items.implication: Trending toward availability vs MIA; monitor snaps if limited.
items.opportunity: Potential lead back role if cleared; Braelon Allen handcuff value drops.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical at facility (non-football). MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers; OL mess too. Discussed long-term Jacobs outlook on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Access signals progress post-issue; backups inefficient EPA.
items.implication: Positive for Jacobs ROS value once cleared; fade Lloyd/Johnson short-term.
items.opportunity: Jacobs workload rebound potential; monitor practice.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs this week on layoff.

items.text: Lamar Jackson present for Thursday practice start (limited previously with ankle; walking with limp noted earlier).
items.implication: Game-time lean; high upside if active vs CIN.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) expected to return to practice Thursday and in line to play Monday vs Cowboys.
items.why: Hamstring progressing; roster moves signal confidence.
items.implication: RB2+ floor vs soft DAL run D even without Hurts; monitor volume.
items.opportunity: Primary carries/routes/goal-line; reduces Dameon Pierce role.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): Bears good for yardage; Brown back in real role with usage and matchup.
items.why: Removed from injury report/full practice; elite matchup vs Bears.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high target/yardage ceiling.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6), Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): big workloads/friendly matchups; Lions D gift to pass catchers, RBs carved up by opposing Ds.
A.J. Brown removed from injury report / full participation for Patriots.
Snaps & Pace Week 7 free: TB/CAR and GB/DET/LAR/LV high volume/up pace (Packers-Lions fantasy-friendliest, Rams-Raiders party); MIA/NYJ and SF/ATL and IND/MIN slogs (low snaps/points).
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE/explosive rates; penalties muting volume overall but these games stand out.
items.implication: Prioritize high-pace games for volume plays; avoid slogs.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes/carries in up-pace spots for listed players.

items.text: Chiefs officially placed OT Josh Simmons on injured reserve (bulging disc, no surgery needed); eligible Week 11.
items.why: Plateaued in rehab per trainer; misses at least 4 games.
items.implication: OL impact for Mahomes/Rice/Worthy protection and run game.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11): elite volume and matchup juice.
items.why: Seeing elite volume; soft DAL secondary.
items.implication: WR2 with upside even without Hurts.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Travis Kelce @ SEA, Josh Jacobs @ DET, Cam Skattebo @ HOU: nasty matchups, target-share issues, layoff workload questions, role squeeze.
items.why: Tough Ds, low scoring, post-layoff, squeezed roles.
items.implication: Sit or fade; better options available.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive ROS on Jacobs.
